results.name: exp_off
results.why: the exponent is one too small: the largest part does not fit

results.name: bl_off
results.why: the bit length is one too small

results.name: mag_not_xored
results.why: negative real parts are not turned into their ones-complement magnitude: the OR sees the sign bits

results.name: imag_ignored
results.why: the imaginary parts do not enter the exponent

results.name: acc_not_restarted
results.why: the OR is not cleared at a frame start: the largest earlier frame sets this one's exponent

results.name: round_inverted
results.why: the rounding constant is added in the truncating mode and not in the rounding mode

results.name: round_half_off
results.why: the rounding constant is a whole unit, not a half

results.name: saturation_to_zero
results.why: a part that the rounding carries to 2**(W-1) becomes zero instead of saturating

results.name: left_shift_zero_ext
results.why: a negative word is zero-extended before the shift

results.name: acc_bank
results.why: the exponent is taken from the other bank's OR

results.name: bank_not_toggled
results.why: the write bank never changes: a frame overwrites the one before it

results.name: full_clear_other
results.why: the wrong bank is released

results.name: order_swapped
results.why: natural and bit-reversed output order exchanged

results.name: sof_on_last
results.why: out_sof marks the last word

results.name: exp_not_aligned
results.why: the exponent is two clocks ahead of the data (visible when frames follow each other with different levels)

results.name: exp_zero
results.why: the exponent output is not driven

results.name: core_scaled
results.why: the core runs scaled: the output is 1/N of the unscaled transform in the wide words

results.name: core_natural
results.why: the core reorders to natural order and the store reads bit-reversed: the order is scrambled

results.name: hold_missing
results.why: the read-out does not stall: words are lost while the sink is not ready

results.name: rd_not_held
results.why: the memory output register is not held while the output is stalled

results.name: exp_not_held
results.why: the exponent pipeline register is not held while the output is stalled

results.name: wr_always_ready
results.why: the core is never held back: a frame overwrites a bank that is still being read

results.name: core_not_stalled
results.why: the core's output is never stalled by the full frame store
